name: Bender

inputs: Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: Bender
Biroul Național de Statistică, Recensământul Populației și Locuințelor 2024, annex tables 5.33 and 5.35 (by ethnicity)
religion.note: Not read: no census that counted Bender has published its religious affiliation. Modelled from its ethnic composition in Transnistria's 2015 census, each group given the religious affiliation its members declared in Moldova's 2024 census. Assumes the left bank's Russians, Ukrainians and Moldovans answer as the right bank's do; the left bank is more Russian-speaking, so this understates Russian. People whose ethnicity was not recorded are given the declared mix.

inputs: Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: Bender
Biroul Național de Statistică, Recensământul Populației și Locuințelor 2024, annex tables 5.33 and 5.35 (by ethnicity)
language.note: Not read: no census that counted Bender has published its mother tongue. Modelled from its ethnic composition in Transnistria's 2015 census, each group given the mother tongue its members declared in Moldova's 2024 census. Assumes the left bank's Russians, Ukrainians and Moldovans answer as the right bank's do; the left bank is more Russian-speaking, so this understates Russian as a mother tongue. People whose ethnicity was not recorded are given the declared mix. Moldovan and Romanian are given as one, the census's own sum: which name people use differs between the banks, and the right bank's split would mean nothing here.

name: Transnistria

inputs: Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: Transnistria
Biroul Național de Statistică, Recensământul Populației și Locuințelor 2024, annex tables 5.33 and 5.35 (by ethnicity)
religion.note: Not read: no census that counted Transnistria has published its religious affiliation. Modelled from its ethnic composition in Transnistria's 2015 census, each group given the religious affiliation its members declared in Moldova's 2024 census. Assumes the left bank's Russians, Ukrainians and Moldovans answer as the right bank's do; the left bank is more Russian-speaking, so this understates Russian. People whose ethnicity was not recorded are given the declared mix.

inputs: Transnistria's 2015 census, ethnic composition by district, as pop-stat.mashke.org compiles it: Transnistria
Biroul Național de Statistică, Recensământul Populației și Locuințelor 2024, annex tables 5.33 and 5.35 (by ethnicity)
language.note: Not read: no census that counted Transnistria has published its mother tongue. Modelled from its ethnic composition in Transnistria's 2015 census, each group given the mother tongue its members declared in Moldova's 2024 census. Assumes the left bank's Russians, Ukrainians and Moldovans answer as the right bank's do; the left bank is more Russian-speaking, so this understates Russian as a mother tongue. People whose ethnicity was not recorded are given the declared mix. Moldovan and Romanian are given as one, the census's own sum: which name people use differs between the banks, and the right bank's split would mean nothing here.
